summary: Verified the PulseFitness Service Desk bug fix: PPM jobs allocated via POST /api/svc/ppm/schedule now reach the engineer's job list. Backend end-to-end test (owner@isodemo.com) allocates a PPM to self and to jordan.blake; the resulting svc_cases doc has status='assigned' (lowercase) and assigned_engineer_id set, and the case appears in GET /api/svc/engineer/jobs for when=open and when=today. Both regression tests pass (2/2).
critical_code_review_comments: ppm_calendar.py schedule_ppm() now writes status 'assigned' (lowercase) matching OPEN_STATES in utils/svc_state.py — fix is correct.

Consider adding an invariant / enum type for svc_cases.status to prevent future casing drift. The engineer_jobs query trusts lowercase canonical states; any writer must honour that contract. Introducing a shared Pydantic Literal/Enum (e.g. CaseStatus) used by every writer would eliminate this class of case-sensitivity bugs.
Suggest adding a quick migration/healer on startup that normalizes svc_cases.status to lowercase, in case any other writer still produces uppercase values.

seed_data_creation: Tests may create a new PPM schedule via POST /api/svc/ppm/schedules only if none is found via /api/svc/ppm/search. Each test run also creates a new svc_cases doc (ppm) under organization iso-demo-org — these are not deleted; cleanup can be added if accumulation is a concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test file: /app/backend/tests/test_svc_ppm_engineer_allocation.py. Run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_svc_ppm_engineer_allocation.py -v -s`. It (1) finds-or-creates a PPM schedule for iso-demo-org, (2) allocates it via POST /api/svc/ppm/schedule to owner (iso-owner), (3) asserts GET /api/svc/engineer/jobs returns the ppm case with status=='assigned' for when=open and when=today, (4) also allocates to jordan.blake and reads /api/svc/cases/{id} to confirm persisted status=='assigned' and assigned_engineer_id. The fix in routes/svc/ppm_calendar.py (line ~911 status: 'assigned') is verified correct.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: utils/svc_state.py defines ASSIGNED='assigned' and OPEN_STATES as a set of lowercase canonical states. GET /api/svc/engineer/jobs filters db.svc_cases with {status: {$in: OPEN_STATES}}. The PPM allocate path in routes/svc/ppm_calendar.py::schedule_ppm() previously wrote status='ASSIGNED' (uppercase) to svc_cases on allocation, so Mongo (case-sensitive) excluded those docs from the engineer's query and the engineer saw an empty list despite being assigned. Fix: write 'assigned' (lowercase) at line ~911 of ppm_calendar.py; a one-off DB heal normalized existing stuck docs. Reproduction (pre-fix): allocate any PPM via POST /api/svc/ppm/schedule, then GET /api/svc/engineer/jobs?when=open — case missing. Post-fix verification: same flow — case present with status 'assigned'. Mitigation suggestion: enforce a shared CaseStatus enum on every writer, and add a startup normalizer for legacy uppercase values.
